> 第726章 兽潮来临（第1页）
普通兽潮不足为惧，可这头拥有灵智的首领，才是今夜守城最大的杀招。它不靠蛮力破城，而是以战术耗损众人战力、以浊气分化各族同盟，远比无脑冲杀的异兽恐怖百倍。
没有丝毫迟疑，林鹤清不再隐藏身形、收敛手段。
他指尖灵力暴涨，原本细碎内敛的灵力刃丝瞬间化作万千凌厉银芒，穿透重重夜色与兽潮，精准锁死虚空深处那道人形暗影。
同时心念传讯四门：兽潮有智，刻意分化合围，全员死守点位，切勿被杂念挑动内讧，各司其职、互为驰援！
一声无形心念传遍四方，瞬间稳住各族慌乱的心神。
城下，万千异兽依旧悍不畏死疯狂冲击。
城头，各族修士摒弃杂念、咬牙死战。
明面上是万族天骄死守孤城、血战兽潮，暗处却是林鹤清与异兽首领的极致博弈，一方布局破城，一方死守防线、拆解算计，第二夜的凶险鏖战，彻底进入白热化。
异兽首领察觉到锁定自身的锋锐气息，漆黑竖瞳微微收缩，盘旋在虚空黑雾之中，立刻变更了原本的进攻排布。
原本集中冲击南门的中端异兽群，分出一大半，化作两道狭长的兽潮洪流，绕开正面的术法阵线，贴着城墙外壁的阴影区域迂回游走，打算避开各族修士的正面攻击，从城墙凹凸的缺口处向上攀爬，打守军一个侧面突袭。
它还调动了数头身披厚重虚空甲壳的巨型异兽，沉在后方，借着周围漫天嘶吼掩盖动静，缓缓朝着东门人族与草木精体衔接的薄弱地带挪动，想要撕开联防的衔接缝隙。
林鹤清手腕微抬，四散铺开的灵力刃丝骤然分化，一部分丝线化作细密的网，横向切割迂回游走的异兽，银亮的细丝划过黑暗，将攀在墙面上的异兽躯体切割开一道道细碎伤口，逼得它们阵型散乱，难以有序堆叠成梯。
另一部分刃丝汇聚成数道细长的光矛，顺着虚空缝隙穿透浓重黑雾，直刺异兽首领周身的护体浊气。
那头人形异兽首领抬手搅动身边的虚空黑雾，黑色的雾浪层层叠叠挡在身前，硬生生拦下了迎面而来的光矛，爆炸开的气浪将周遭游荡的低阶异兽震得四分五裂。
趁着阻拦攻势的间隙，它再次催动浊气，一股带着蛊惑意味的波动顺着夜风飘向城头，精准落在几名灵力消耗过大的妖族修士身上。
那几名妖修本就身心疲惫，心底残留的猜忌被再次放大，下意识放缓了出手的速度，看向身旁协防的魔族修士，眼神里多了几分戒备，一小段防线瞬间出现了短暂的空当。
墙外等候已久的异兽抓住空隙，嘶吼着向上扑跃。
北门值守的魔族巡查修士第一时间察觉到异动，魔刃横挥，漆黑的魔气斩开扑上来的异兽，同时高声出声提醒身旁的妖族同伴，将涣散的心神拉回战场。

躲在阴影里的黑豆立刻动身，身形化作一道黑影，跃到外墙的空档之处，锋利的爪牙接连撕碎两头率先登墙的高阶异兽，把即将成型的突破口硬生生封堵下来。

A mortal cultivating immortality, I am just a passerby. The latest chapter_Chapter 726 The beast tide is coming. Page 1_A mortal cultivating immortality, I am just a passerby and a consumable._Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 726 The Beast Tide is Coming (Page 1)
Ordinary beast tides are not something to be afraid of, but this leader with intelligence is the biggest killer move in defending the city tonight. It does not rely on brute force to break the city, but uses tactics to consume everyone's fighting power and divides the alliances of various races with its turbid energy. It is far more terrifying than a mindless beast.
Without any hesitation, Lin Heqing no longer concealed his figure or restrained his methods.
The spiritual power of his fingertips surged, and the originally fine and restrained spiritual power blades instantly turned into thousands of sharp silver lights, penetrating the night and the beast tide, and accurately locked the humanoid shadow in the depths of the void.
At the same time, he sent messages to the four gates in his mind: The beast tide is wise, and they are deliberately dividing the encirclement. All members stick to their positions, do not let distracting thoughts provoke internal strife, each performs his or her duties, and supports each other!
An invisible thought spread in all directions, instantly calming the panicked minds of all races.
Under the city, thousands of strange beasts are still fearless and attack madly.
At the top of the city, monks from all races abandoned their distracting thoughts and gritted their teeth to fight to the death.
On the bright side, the geniuses of all races defended the isolated city and fought bloody battles with the beasts, but in the dark, it was the ultimate game between Lin Heqing and the leader of the alien beasts. One side planned to break the city, and the other side defended the defense line and dismantled the plan. The dangerous and fierce battle on the second night completely entered a fierce battle.
The leader of the alien beast noticed the sharp aura locked on him, his dark vertical pupils shrank slightly, hovering in the black mist of the void, and he immediately changed his original attack arrangement.
The middle group of alien beasts that were originally focused on attacking the south gate split into two long and narrow torrents of beasts, bypassing the frontal magic array and wandering around the shadow area of ​​the outer wall of the city wall. They planned to avoid the frontal attacks of the monks of various races, climb up from the concave and convex gaps in the city wall, and attack the defenders from the side.
It also mobilized several giant alien beasts with thick void carapace, which sank behind, covering up the movement with the roars all around, and slowly moved towards the weak area connecting the Dongmen human race and the vegetation essence, trying to tear open the gap in the joint defense.
Lin Heqing raised his wrist slightly, and the scattered spiritual blade threads suddenly separated. Part of the threads turned into a fine network, cutting horizontally the wandering alien beasts. The bright silver threads cut through the darkness, cutting tiny wounds into the bodies of the alien beasts hanging on the wall, forcing them to scatter in formation, making it difficult to stack them in an orderly manner.
The other part of the blades converged into several slender spears of light, which penetrated the thick black mist along the gaps in the void and pierced the body-protecting turbidity around the leader of the alien beasts.
The leader of the humanoid alien beast raised his hand to stir up the black fog in the void around him. The black fog waves piled up in front of him, blocking the oncoming light spear. The explosive air waves shook the low-level alien beasts wandering around to pieces.
Taking advantage of the gap to block the offensive, it stirred up the turbid air again, and a wave of bewitching waves floated along the night wind towards the city, and landed accurately on several demon monks who had consumed too much spiritual power.
Those demon cultivators were already exhausted both physically and mentally, and the residual suspicion in their hearts was magnified again. They subconsciously slowed down their attack speed, and looked at the demon cultivators who were assisting in the defense. Their eyes were a little more wary, and a small gap in the defense line instantly appeared for a short period of time.
The alien beast that had been waiting for a long time outside the wall seized the gap and jumped upwards with a roar.
The demon patrolling monk on duty at the north gate noticed the abnormal movement immediately. He swung the demon blade horizontally and slashed away the attacking beast with the dark demonic energy. At the same time, he loudly reminded the demon companions beside him to bring his distracted mind back to the battlefield.
Heidou, who was hiding in the shadows, immediately took off, transformed into a black shadow, and jumped to the gap in the outer wall. His sharp claws tore apart the two high-level alien beasts that were the first to climb the wall, blocking the upcoming breach.
